content:
Field
Description
AccountId
The account ID of the corresponding cloud provider
Region
The region for the corresponding cloud resource
ResourceId
The cloud resource identifier
ResourceIdType
The type of the detected resource identifier
PolicyStatement
The statement of the associated policy
PolicyId
The ID of the associated policy
Severity
The severity score associated with the event
SeverityName
The severity level of the detection, as a string (High/Medium/Informational)
CloudPlatform
The name of cloud platform.
CloudService
The name of cloud service associated with the resource
Disposition
The disposition of this event (Failed/Passed)
ResourceUrl
The URL to the cloud resource
Finding
The details of the finding
ResourceAttributes
A JSON blob with all resource attributes
Tags
Tags on the cloud resources if any
ReportUrl
The URL to the Falcon report
ResourceName
Resource name if any
ResourceCreateTime
The resource creation time
Timestamp
Time the event happened
